title: Recover a scanned connection when its first reply is lost
summary: Retry a QR join up to three times with the same random attempt ID. The server returns the same session only to that matching code, attempt and network peer.

changes.detail: Recover lost join responses, including response-body failures, without automatically consuming another QR. Replays with another attempt, pairing code or peer cannot obtain the session token.
Native and browser regression coverage for idempotent join and a guide for real-phone acceptance.

validation.name: Direct viewer tests
validation.detail: Eight viewer tests pass including lost-reply retry using the identical random attempt ID.
